name: my-corner
description: A personal blog in four eras of computing. Posts are Markdown files in R2.

CONTENT.description: The R2 bucket that holds your posts and photos. The default name is fine.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Zero Trust team domain, like `yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. Type `none` for now; the README shows where to find it.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Application Audience (AUD) tag of your back-office Access application. Type `none` for now.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The only email allowed into the back office. Type `none` to rely on the Access policy alone.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Shown to OpenStreetMap's place search, as its usage policy asks. Optional: type `none` to skip.

TIMEZONE.description: Post times are read in this time zone, for example `Europe/London`.
